args.complete_required_delivery_text:
Man-to-man defensive positioning

The UGA chapter introduces a positioning example for a defender facing an opponent with the ball in a man-to-man scheme. In that setting, it suggests noticing which hand the opponent prefers for dribbling and using positioning to discourage movement toward that preferred side. Its example concerns a right-handed ball handler and a defender trying to encourage movement to the other side. The example depends on the defensive strategy and the opponent’s tendencies. It is a source-described tactical concept, not a mandatory defense for every player or game.

General introductory basketball reference, selected and paraphrased from the cited chapter. No youth-specific suitability, training dose, medical clearance or planner approval is established.

Source: 6. Fundamentals – Defending, Ch.1 - Basketball, UGA PEDB Program. https://open.online.uga.edu/basketball/chapter/2-basketball-fundamentals-skills-and-techniques/
